mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% indicates an active monetary easing cycle that lowers discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during accommodative policy periods.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 4.5% signals labor market tightening that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) above their 3-month moving averages indicate robust economic expansion across demand and supply sectors, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and INDPRO rising) fails to predict positive 20d returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 3.0% YoY indicates persistent inflation that triggers central bank hawkish policy, increasing real interest rates and compressing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in high inflation regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1000 thousand units signal strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1000.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrently low federal funds rate (below 3.0%) and low unemployment rate (below 4.5%) indicate accommodative monetary policy combined with tight labor market conditions, fueling economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS < 3.0% and UNRATE < 4.5%) fails to predict positive 20d returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth below 0.5% MoM indicates supply constraints that reduce corporate output and signal potential recession risks, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days in supply constraint regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO growth < 0.5% MoM.
